beats.what: Camps ran on October 10 and 11. Of 3,364 forms issued, 2,483 came back filled.
beats.why: The district election office is updating rolls. Commissioner G S Sameeran inspected a camp in Virugambakkam.

hook: Turned 18 or moved flats? *Form 6 or Form 8* is your ticket

learn.t: Form 6 is for new voters; Form 8 is for shifting address, fixing roll entries or replacing a voter ID.
